cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said vintage so firmly that I've put it in the listing. Shall we sell your guitar and replace the fridge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Vintage doesn't mean old enough to throw out. I played my first concert on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, concert history. We'll put that in too; the next player will know what they're getting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the amplifier. I still play the guitar every Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then call it a Sunday player, just as you do. Let me record one last Sunday for you; a buyer can hear it, and you'll keep the performance.
